evidence: DOM markup shows Skip Main Navigation, but no target element with id="main" exists in DOM. Focus remains stranded at document root.

recommendation: Add semantic <main id="main-content" tabindex="-1"> to root layout and update anchor link to href="#main-content". Ensure prominent :focus-visible banner displays on tab.

wcag_reference: 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (Level A) & 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
evidence: DOM markup <input type="text" name="search-terms" placeholder="Search" id="search-terms"> lacks <label for="search-terms">, aria-label, or aria-labelledby. Placeholder text has 2.1:1 contrast and disappears on input.
user_impact: Screen reader users hear only 'edit text' with no context. Low-vision users and individuals with cognitive impairments lose context once characters are typed.
recommendation: Provide an explicit <label for="search-terms" class="sr-only">Search NYC 311 Services and Knowledge Base</label> with persistent visual floating label and high-contrast hint.
